data.notes: August 2026 is already anchored by Summer Sonic in Chiba/Makuhari, with a strong run of arena, Zepp, and Budokan-scale Japanese and international concerts around Tokyo.

events.title: Phantom Siita Zepp TOUR 2026 “Phantom Land”
events.summary: Phantom Siita’s first national Zepp tour closes its announced run with a Tokyo date at Zepp Haneda. The official announcement lists the August 1 Tokyo show and 16:30/17:30 open/start time.

events.title: 2026 JAEJOONG ZEPP & HALL LIVE TOUR – 4% –
events.summary: Jaejoong’s official 2026 Zepp & Hall tour schedule lists two August 2 performances at Pacifico Yokohama National Hall. Yokohama is very near Tokyo and commonly included in the Greater Tokyo live circuit.

events.title: Tokyo Ska Paradise Orchestra Live House TOUR “VerSus Carnival” with Saucy Dog
events.summary: Tokyo Ska Paradise Orchestra brings its “VerSus Carnival” live-house tour to Zepp Haneda with guest Saucy Dog. Hot Stuff Promotion lists the date, venue, and 19:00 start.

events.title: Tokyo Ska Paradise Orchestra Live House TOUR “VerSus Carnival” with Hiromi
events.summary: Tokyo Ska Paradise Orchestra’s second Zepp Haneda night features jazz pianist Hiromi as guest. The promoter page confirms August 7 at Zepp Haneda with 18:00 doors and 19:00 start.

events.title: KOTORI pre. “12” Tour
events.summary: KOTORI’s 2026 one-man tour includes a Tokyo stop at Zepp DiverCity. SMASH lists the August 7 date, venue, and 18:00/19:00 open/start time.

events.title: T-BOLAN LAST LIVE FINAL CHAPTER 2026.08.10 NIPPON BUDOKAN “This Journey Never Ends”
events.summary: T-BOLAN’s last-live final chapter is confirmed for Nippon Budokan on August 10. The official information page lists the Budokan date and 17:30/18:30 open/start time.

events.title: SUMMER SONIC 2026 Tokyo
events.summary: Summer Sonic Tokyo’s official 2026 lineup page confirms the three Tokyo dates and daily artist bills, including The Strokes, Jennie, Ado, David Byrne, L’Arc-en-Ciel, Jamiroquai, BABYMETAL, LE SSERAFIM, and more. The Tokyo info page lists ZOZO Marine Stadium and Makuhari Messe as the venues.

events.title: Natural Lag Live Tour 2026 -Special Edition-
events.summary: Natural Lag’s official site lists its special edition tour date at Nippon Budokan on August 16. The page confirms the Tokyo Budokan show with 17:00/18:00 open/start time.

events.title: Kana Nishino TOUR 2026 “HEART BEAT”
events.summary: Kana Nishino’s 2026 national hall tour includes an August 19 Tokyo International Forum Hall A performance. Hot Stuff Promotion confirms the date, venue, and 17:30/18:30 open/start time.

events.title: METALVERSE / MORE STAR “VERSE BY VERSE #1”
events.summary: METALVERSE and MORE STAR are confirmed for “VERSE BY VERSE #1” at Zepp Haneda. The promoter listing gives the August 25 date, venue, and 18:00/19:00 open/start time.

events.title: [Alexandros] YOU ARE WELCOME TOUR
events.summary: [Alexandros]’ official site lists an August 26 Tokyo show at Zepp Haneda as part of the YOU ARE WELCOME TOUR. The schedule confirms 18:00 doors and 19:00 start.

events.title: Electric Callboy TANZNEID WORLD TOUR JAPAN
events.summary: Electric Callboy’s official Japan tour page confirms a Tokyo Garden Theater date on August 31. The listing is for the band’s TANZNEID WORLD TOUR JAPAN and includes overseas ticketing information.
